workflow.title: Waste Characterization & Hazardous Waste Determination
workflow.description: Authoritative Connecticut and federal resources for identifying, classifying, testing, and documenting a waste stream before downstream generator compliance.

relationships.workflow_note: Consult the Connecticut regulatory framework and incorporated federal provisions governing waste identification and hazardous-waste determinations.
Use when organizing and documenting the Connecticut determination, including exclusions, listings, characteristics, process knowledge, testing, and supporting records.
Open when evaluating federal solid-waste concepts and exclusions that may be relevant to the material under review.
Use as a federal reference for listed-waste categories, hazardous-waste characteristics, and related identification concepts.
Consult when evaluating whether a non-RCRA waste may fall within a Connecticut-specific regulated-waste category.
Use to identify current EPA sampling, preparation, analytical, and quality-assurance resources when testing is part of the professional determination.
Use to locate Connecticut-approved laboratories and review relevant certified matrices or analytes before commissioning waste analysis.
